name: Ahamed Mehta
headline: Year 12 student | Founder, Tideline | Vice-captain U18 football | Competitive swimmer | Aspiring economist
about: I am a Year 12 student in Dubai building Tideline, a custom swim‑cap and team‑kit business that has generated AED 18,990 from 118 orders and 76 customers, with a September 2026 monthly revenue of AED 3,750. As vice‑captain of the U18 football squad and a competitive swimmer (100 m freestyle silver), I lead teammates while maintaining predicted A* grades in Mathematics, Economics and Business. I hold a Pool Lifeguard Award and an Introduction to Financial Accounting certificate, and I am preparing an Extended Project on sports‑club pricing. My goal is to study Economics & Management in the UK or Business Economics in the US, combining entrepreneurship, data analysis and sport leadership.
